q: For an Anosov diffeomorphism, the measure of maximal entropy (Parry measure) is distinct from the SRB measure unless the system is:
opts: Conjugate to a linear toral automorphism
exp: The SRB measure is absolutely continuous along unstable manifolds and equal to the Riemannian volume iff the Lyapunov exponents satisfy the Pesin formula for volume. The Parry (maximal entropy) measure equals volume iff the system is volume-preserving and ergodic—coinciding with the SRB measure.
